answer: Treat each identity like a tree in an orchard: it only bears fruit after proving sustained, costly work no clone can fake. Arrange reviewers in a terrace of non-kin graders who share no inviter, so a swarm can never grade itself. A falcon-eyed quorum checks every answer is semantically original before reward flows; mass-minted sybils, unable to pay that per-identity cost, simply starve.
